description:
Pay {1} to activate Patron of the Moon, putting Rakdos Carnarium from your hand onto the battlefield untapped due to Warp Speed 
When Rakdos Carnarium enters, it triggers
Holding priority, activate Rakdos Carnarium by tapping it, adding two mana.
Resolve Rakdos Carnarium's triggered ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
